assumptions: CI concurrency group keyed on github.sha for non-PR events, because cancel-in-progress false alone still replaces a pending run, so 'every push to main ends with a CI result' needs it (extends change.md fix direction 1)
Release job also requires workflow_run.event == 'push' and workflow_run.head_sha == github.sha, so a fork PR branch named main or a moved main cannot release an untested commit
A rerun of a failed CI run re-fires workflow_run with conclusion success (change.md assumes it; checked live in row 3.5)
Job-level concurrency in release.yml stops a skipped job taking the pending slot (checked live in row 3.6)
The setting 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' still applies to a workflow_run job (row 3.7)
Tests match workflow text with comment lines stripped, in a new file tools/test/release-gate.test.mjs, because no YAML parser is allowed (ADR-006)
